title: Getting around Malta
intro: The strongest public-transport candidate for event travel is Malta Public Transport route 186 between the Qawra and Ta’ Qali Stadium stops. The operator’s journey planner is the final check for the exact stop, direction, time and service alert on each date; the event’s public match and door times were not available in the sources checked.

records.name: Practical mode comparison: public bus vs ride-share/taxis vs ferries vs rental car
records.area: Island-wide & Qawra ↔ Attard / Ta’ Qali event corridor
records.address: AX ODYCY (Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902) ↔ Malta International Airport, BLAST Arena Studios (Attard / Ta’ Qali), Valletta, Sliema, and Gozo
records.hours: Depends on mode: Route 186 lists Qawra stop 952 at 06:09–21:39 (30-min intervals) and last return arrival at Buġibba Bay 1 (stop 2527) at 21:27; TD1 serves Qawra stop Arznell 950 hourly (05:42–00:35 from airport; 05:27–23:27 to airport); ride-hailing/taxis operate on demand (Malta Taxi advertises 24/7); ferries follow seasonal timetables.
records.price range: Public bus: €2.00 winter / €2.50 summer 2-hr day single (Oct 2026 window unconfirmed), €3.50 TD1, €19 12-journey card, €25 7-day Explore Adult; Ferries: €3.00–€8.50 published adult fares; Ride-share/taxi & Car hire: live quote required
records.description: Side-by-side comparison across convenience, price, value, and feasibility: (1) Public buses (MPT) offer the lowest cost and highest day-to-day value via Route 186 (Qawra ↔ Ta’ Qali Stadium stop 6227), Route 214, and Airport Direct TD1 (serving Qawra stop Arznell 950), but have lower late-night return convenience because Route 186’s return serves St Paul’s Bay/Buġibba (last arrival 21:27 at Buġibba Bay 1) rather than Qawra seafront and is diverted on Saturday 17 October after 19:00. (2) Ride-share/taxis (Bolt, eCabs, Malta Taxi) give the highest door-to-door convenience and late-night feasibility for post-Playoffs returns or airport transfers with luggage, at higher per-ride cost (live app quotes required). (3) Ferries (Valletta Ferry Services, Gozo Channel, Gozo Highspeed) offer high scenic value and harbour/island convenience for Valletta ↔ Sliema/Three Cities and Gozo day trips, but are weather-dependent (with 14 and 17 Oct Gozo Highspeed notices) and do not serve inland Attard/Ta’ Qali. (4) Car hire (Park East at MLA) provides flexibility for rural sightseeing but has lower value/feasibility for a Qawra-based event trip due to left-hand driving, narrow congested roads, parking constraints, and direct bus/ride-share alternatives.
records.notes: Synthesizes verified operator sources checked 9–11 October 2026: MPT fares (https://www.publictransport.com.mt/fares-and-tickets/), Route 186 (https://www.publictransport.com.mt/route/186/), Route TD1 (https://www.publictransport.com.mt/route/TD1/), Bolt Malta (https://bolt.eu/en/cities/malta/), eCabs (https://ecabs.com.mt/), Malta Taxi (https://www.maltataxi.mt/), Valletta Ferry Services (https://www.vallettaferryservices.com/), Gozo Channel (https://www.gozochannel.com/ferry/fares/passenger/), Gozo Highspeed (https://gozohighspeed.com/pages/fares), MLA car rental (https://maltairport.com/renting-a-car/), and U.S. State Department road-safety guidance (https://travel.state.gov/en/international-travel/travel-advisories/malta.html). Exact ride-share/rental quotes and event-day door-to-door walking times remain trip-specific.

records.name: Thunderpick World Championship 2026 — dates and venue
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, Millennium Stand, Attard ATD 4000, Malta (Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre, Ta’ Qali, Ħ’Attard). The Thunderpick entrance, gate and attendee instructions are not confirmed.
records.hours: Official TWC page lists the overall event window 12–19 October 2026: arrival 12 October, media day 13 October, Group Stage 14–16 October, Playoffs 17–18 October, departure 19 October. It does not publish daily public match/door times or attendee instructions.
records.description: The official Thunderpick page confirms the overall window and phase dates and lists Malta as the location. A Thunderpick press release names BLAST Studios Malta as the Finals venue. Liquipedia places BLAST Arena Studios in Attard, and venue listings and BLAST’s attendee guide give the MFCC/Ta’ Qali address for the same venue. The venue address is therefore corroborated; the spectator entrance, tickets and daily public times are not.
records.notes: Official TWC page rechecked 11 Oct 2026 (still lists Malta only). Venue corroboration checked 11 Oct 2026: Liquipedia TWC 2026 page (location Attard; venue BLAST Arena Studios): https://liquipedia.net/counterstrike/Thunderpick/World_Championship/2026 ; Thunderpick press release naming BLAST Studios Malta: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/thunderpick-world-championship-2026-returns-to-malta-with-1-million-prize-pool-302850221.html ; visitmalta directory address for BLAST Arena Studios: https://www.visitmalta.co.uk/business-directory/business/blast-arena-studios-malta ; EventWorks listing for a BLAST event at the same venue (30 Jul 2026): https://eventworks.mt/premier-bounty-presented-by-polymarket ; BLAST attendee guide for BLAST Bounty at BLAST Arena Studios, giving the MFCC/Ta’ Qali address: https://blast.tv/cs/news/malta-fan-guide . Do not transfer earlier BLAST event access rules or door times to the Thunderpick Finals.

records.name: Qawra ↔ Ta’ Qali / BLAST Arena Studios — Route 186
records.address: MPT timetable lists Qawra stop 952 and the Ta’ Qali “Stadium” stop (ID 6227) on Route 186. Whether that stop or another gives the easiest walk to the BLAST Arena Studios entrance is not verified; confirm in the planner.
records.hours: MPT’s static Route 186 timetable (checked 11 Oct 2026) lists Qawra stop 952 at 30-minute intervals from 06:09 to 21:39 in the Rabat-bound direction, reaching Ta’ Qali Stadium stop 6227 about 30 minutes later (06:39–22:08). The Rabat-to-Buġibba return direction was re-read 11 Oct 2026: it serves Ta’ Qali Stadium stop 2194 (05:52–20:53), then St Paul’s Bay stops Mwiezeb 956 and Imhasel 958 and stops Toni 6013 and Gillieru 6014 before Buġibba; it does not serve the Qawra seafront stops (950–955), and its last listed arrival at Buġibba Bay 1 (stop 2527) is 21:27. Use the live planner for date-and-time-specific departures and for the stop nearest the hotel; this is not a trip-day guarantee.
records.description: Route 186 is the clearest direct bus candidate found for the event commute: the operator’s route timetable lists both Qawra stop 952 and a Ta’ Qali stadium-area stop. From Qawra, select the Rabat-bound service; from Ta’ Qali, select the Buġibba-bound return. The standard return continues via St Paul’s Bay/Buġibba rather than Qawra’s seafront. These are route-level timetable details, not a confirmed hotel-to-venue itinerary or a guarantee of a trip-day return. Confirm the walk to the BLAST Arena Studios entrance, event-time departures, the onward hotel connection and any service alert in the live planner.
records.notes: Route stop rows checked 11 Oct 2026 on https://www.publictransport.com.mt/route/186/: the Qawra - 952 and Stadium - 6227 rows (Qawra→Ta’ Qali direction) and the Stadium - 2194 and Buġibba Bay 1 - 2527 rows (return direction). Stop 2194 is the return-direction Ta’ Qali stadium stop; 6227 is the outbound one. For the Saturday 17 October evening detour, see the separate Route 186 notice. Also seen 11 Oct 2026: stop Saqqajja (ID 4627), on the Rabat side of Route 186 and several other routes, is closed for construction until approximately 1 January; this affects journeys continuing to Rabat/Mdina, not the Qawra–Ta’ Qali segment. The journey planner is https://www.publictransport.com.mt/journey-planner/. Fare rates: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/fares-and-tickets/ (its displayed seasonal dates do not cover October 2026).
records.price range: Regular day-route fare; MPT lists €2 winter / €2.50 summer cash-contactless rates, but the applicable 2026 October fare window was not established

records.name: Route 186 diversion — Saturday 17 October evening
records.address: Route 186 toward Buġibba; affected stops listed by MPT are Gholja 2 through Targa
records.hours: MPT notice: 19:00 to approximately 00:00, starting 17 October and ending 18 October 2026
records.description: A currently published Malta Public Transport notice says Route 186 is diverted on Friday/Saturday evenings from 19:00, starting 17 October, and that stops from Gholja 2 through Targa toward Buġibba will not be served. This overlaps the TWC Playoffs weekend and may matter for the return journey. The notice does not publish TWC-specific service details; check the live planner and service updates before relying on a particular stop or departure.
records.notes: Re-checked 11 Oct 2026 on the MPT route page service-update box and the MPT service-updates page: weekly Friday/Saturday 19:00–00:00 detour starting 17 October, ending 18 October; toward Buġibba, stops from Gholja 2 through Targa are not served. Friday 16 October is before the stated start, so this notice covers Saturday 17 October evening. The notice specifies affected stops, not a total cancellation of Route 186. Also listed on the MPT service-updates page on 11 Oct 2026: Stop Saqqajja (ID 4627) closed for construction until approximately 1 January on Routes 109, 109A, 181, 182, 186, 201, 202, 50, 51, 52, 53, 56 and N52, plus Tuesday 13 October (09:30–17:30) construction detours on Attard Routes 54 and 106. Recheck on the day.
records.price range: Normal route fare; no separate event fare stated

records.name: MPT weekday/weekend timetable transition for 13–19 October
records.hours: Weekday winter timetable began 21 September 2026; weekend winter timetable begins 7 November 2026
records.description: For this trip, 13–16 October and Monday 19 October fall under the operator’s weekday winter timetable; Saturday 17 and Sunday 18 October remain on the summer weekend timetable. This is a network-level schedule transition only; route-specific departures, journey duration and disruptions must still be checked for each event date.
records.notes: MPT Route 186’s current published notice separately lists the 17 October evening diversion: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/latest-service-updates/.
records.price range: Fare depends on route/card and the applicable seasonal fare period

records.name: Route 214 — alternate Qawra / Ta’ Qali service to compare
records.address: MPT timetable lists Qawra stop 952 and Ta’ Qali stop Qali 2 (2542); walking access to MFCC not verified
records.hours: Check the date-specific planner; do not infer departure time or MFCC walking time from the route name
records.description: MPT’s Route 214 timetable lists both Qawra and Ta’ Qali stops, so it is a second service to compare in the journey planner. Route 186 lists the Ta’ Qali Stadium stop, while Route 214 lists Qali 2; the planner must determine which stop gives the safer/easier walk to the actual MFCC entrance on the selected date.
records.notes: The Route 214 page showed a detour notice for 11 October only when checked; it is outside the trip window, not a guarantee of unchanged service later. Journey planner: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/journey-planner/. Re-check 11 Oct 2026: stop IDs and the 952 Qawra row were not re-verified for Route 214 on this date.
records.price range: Regular day-route fare; exact October 2026 seasonal fare not established

records.name: Malta Airport ↔ Qawra by Airport Direct TD1 (Il-Qawra stop Arznell 950)
records.area: Malta International Airport ↔ Qawra / Buġibba / north Malta
records.address: Malta International Airport bus terminal (Airport 1 stop 2550 outbound; Airport 3 stop 2552 return) ↔ Il-Qawra stop Arznell (ID 950) and Buġibba stops Sajf (947), Bugibba Bay 8 (2339), and Wileg (955). Exact walking distance from Arznell 950 to AX ODYCY must be confirmed in the planner.
records.hours: MPT’s Route TD1 timetable (read 11 Oct 2026) lists hourly departures from Airport 1 (stop 2550) on the hour from 05:00 to 00:00, reaching Il-Qawra stop Arznell (950) about 42–54 minutes later (05:42–00:35). In the Ċirkewwa-to-Airport return direction, TD1 serves Il-Qawra stop Arznell (950) hourly from 05:28 to 23:26 on weekdays (05:27 to 23:27 on weekends), reaching Airport 3 (stop 2552) at 06:08–00:05 (06:07–00:07 weekends).
records.description: MPT’s Airport Direct TD1 connects Malta International Airport with Rabat, Buġibba, Qawra, Mellieħa and Ċirkewwa hourly. Reading the official Route TD1 stop timetable on 11 October 2026 confirms that TD1 serves Il-Qawra at stop Arznell (ID 950) in both directions (rather than Qawra Coast Road stop 952). The buses have luggage space and no pre-booking is needed; use the live journey planner to compare the walk from Arznell 950 to AX ODYCY against Route 214 or a ride-share.
records.notes: Airport Direct overview checked 11 Oct 2026 (https://www.publictransport.com.mt/other-services/airport-direct/): TD1 hourly to Rabat, Buġibba, Mellieħa and Ċirkewwa; TD2 (St Julian’s, Pembroke), TD3 (St Julian’s, Sliema, Gżira, Msida) and TD4 (Valletta, Gozo Fast Ferry) every 30 minutes; TD5 (Rabat, Buġibba) hourly. Without an Unlimited Travel Card, TD1 is €3.50 and the other Airport Direct routes €3; cash or contactless is accepted onboard; the Unlimited Travel Card includes Airport Direct. Official Route TD1 stop timetable read 11 Oct 2026 (https://www.publictransport.com.mt/route/TD1/): confirms Il-Qawra stop Arznell (ID 950) in both directions (05:42–00:35 from Airport 1 stop 2550; 05:28–23:26 weekday / 05:27–23:27 weekend toward Airport 3 stop 2552). Exact walking route from stop Arznell 950 to AX ODYCY remains a journey-planner check.
records.price range: €3.50 per passenger on TD1 without an Unlimited Travel Card; cash or contactless onboard

records.name: Malta Airport ↔ Qawra by Route 214
records.address: MPT Route 214 timetable lists Qawra stop 952; confirm the best hotel-side stop in the journey planner
records.hours: See the operator’s Route 214 timetable and planner for the flight date/time
records.description: Route 214 is another scheduled airport connection and its official timetable lists Qawra stop 952. It may be useful if its departure fits the flight arrival, but compare the live routing and walking distance with Airport Direct TD1 before choosing.
records.notes: Airport Direct fares and airport-terminal information: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/other-services/airport-direct/. Regular route fare chart: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/fares-and-tickets/.
records.price range: Regular day-route fare; exact fare window for October 2026 not confirmed

records.name: Bus fares and visitor travel cards
records.address: Tickets may be purchased onboard by cash or contactless; sales points and machines are listed by MPT
records.hours: Tickets on bus; card validity depends on the selected product
records.description: MPT’s fare page says single day tickets are bought on the bus with cash or a contactless card and are valid for two hours with free transfers. The 12 Single Day Journeys card (€19, shareable, valid six months from first use) suits occasional travellers and groups; the Explore Adult 7-day card (€25, individual) and Explore Flex passes suit longer stays. The fare page states that the €2.00 winter single fare applies from 19 Oct 2025 to 13 Jun 2026; it gives the summer Day Route fare as €2.50 without stating its dates. It does not establish which fare applies on 13–19 Oct 2026, so check before budgeting or buying.
records.notes: MPT fares page checked 11 Oct 2026 (both sessions): https://www.publictransport.com.mt/fares-and-tickets/ . Fare table: Day Routes (Winter) €2.00; Day Routes (Summer) €2.50; Night Routes (N) €3.00; Special Services (S) €3.00; Tallinja Direct Routes (TD) €3.00; TD1 €3.50; a €50 fine applies for travelling without a valid ticket. Cards: 12 Single Day Journeys €19 (shareable, six months from first use); Explore Adult 7-day €25 (individual, excludes tallinja Direct Routes); Explore Flex €21 (4 days) / €27 (7 days), with paid sightseeing add-ons; Explore Child 7-day €7. Airport Direct is included with an Unlimited Travel Card, while TD1 is listed separately at €3.50 without one. Personalized Tallinja-card free-travel rules and TD-route exclusions differ from visitor cards; check the product terms rather than assuming all buses are free. The intro winter-fare validity (19 Oct 2025–13 Jun 2026) does not cover 13–19 Oct 2026, and the chart lists no October 2026 effective window, so the applicable single fare remains unconfirmed. Sales offices and machines: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/office-and-ticket-machine/ .
records.price range: Fare table checked 11 Oct 2026: Day Routes €2.00 (winter, stated period ends 13 Jun 2026) / €2.50 (summer, dates not stated), valid two hours; Night €3.00; Special Services €3.00; TD €3.00; TD1 €3.50; €50 no-ticket fine. Cards: €19 shareable 12-single-day-journeys; €25 Explore Adult 7-day; Explore Flex €21 (4-day) / €27 (7-day); Explore Child 7-day €7. The October 2026 single-fare window is not established on the page

records.name: Ride-hailing and taxi options
records.address: Pickup/drop-off is set in the operator app or agreed with the taxi provider
records.hours: App availability and taxi dispatch depend on live supply; Malta Taxi advertises 24/7 service
records.description: Bolt and eCabs provide app-based ride-hailing; Malta Taxi advertises app/phone booking, vehicle tracking and 24/7 service. These are the practical door-to-door alternatives when a bus connection is late, the event ends after useful departures or luggage is inconvenient. Compare the app quote and pickup pin at the time; no exact event transfer price or car availability is guaranteed here.
records.notes: Operator pages: eCabs https://ecabs.com.mt/ and Malta Taxi https://www.maltataxi.mt/ (phone advertised: +356 2182 3017). Malta Taxi’s self-description as the only official licensed taxi company was not independently verified and is not relied upon. Bolt airport pickup instructions: https://bolt.eu/en/airports/mla/.
records.price range: Live quote required; no trip fare independently verified

records.name: Rental car pickup at Malta International Airport
records.address: Park East, Level 1 (lower level), about a three-minute walk from the terminal, per Malta International Airport
records.hours: Rental desk/vehicle availability depends on the chosen company and reservation
records.description: Malta International Airport says pre-booked rental-car offices and keys are in the separate Park East building, a short walk from the terminal. Hiring a car can help with flexible sightseeing, but it is not necessary to reach Qawra or the Ta’ Qali event area by the published bus routes. Do not assume walk-up availability or a particular rental price.
records.notes: The airport page lists participating rental firms. Driving-side and road-safety advice is covered in the Everyday Guide; rental terms, parking and event-day congestion were not priced or checked.
records.price range: Not quoted; compare date-specific rental, insurance, fuel and parking charges

records.name: Valletta ferry — Sliema and Three Cities
records.address: Operator terminals at Valletta, Sliema and the Three Cities; confirm the correct sailing/landing point
records.hours: Operator publishes summer and winter timetables; the summer timetable runs through 31 October, but check the exact date, Sunday/public-holiday service and weather
records.description: Valletta Ferry Services is useful for crossing the Grand Harbour between Valletta and Sliema or the Three Cities, not as an island-wide substitute for buses. The operator page provides fares and seasonal timetables; these are current published prices, not a promise of a sailing during disruption or bad weather.
records.notes: Confirm the departure, last return, weather and any public-holiday change on the operator site before making a connection.
records.price range: Published adult day single/return €3/€5; night single/return €3.50/€5.20

records.name: Gozo Channel conventional ferry
records.address: Gozo Channel terminals at Ċirkewwa and Mġarr
records.hours: Check the operator’s live timetable, sailing status and ticket conditions
records.description: Gozo Channel is the conventional vehicle/passenger ferry between Malta and Gozo and is a useful option for a Gozo day trip. This is a separate excursion from the Qawra–Ta’ Qali event commute; plan both island-side buses and the return crossing rather than relying on a posted fare alone.
records.notes: Fare and passenger eligibility are subject to the operator’s conditions and can change. Check current schedules and terminal notices before travel.
records.price range: Current passenger tariff lists a standard €4.65 adult fare; ticketing/return conditions must be checked with the operator

records.name: Gozo Highspeed passenger ferry
records.address: Use the operator’s terminal instructions for the selected Malta departure and Gozo arrival
records.hours: Check the operator’s date-specific timetable and live notices; restrictions were displayed for 14 and 17 October 2026
records.description: Gozo Highspeed publishes faster passenger-ferry connections and route-dependent fares. On the operator page checked 9 October, schedule restrictions were shown for 14 and 17 October in connection with the Rolex Middle Sea Race, alongside temporary pedestrian-route works at Mġarr through 31 October. The exact effect on a particular sailing was not established; verify before booking or setting an island day trip.
records.notes: Operator fares and service alerts: https://gozohighspeed.com/pages/fares. Check the timetable/terminal access notice for the precise departure date and time.
records.price range: Published standard adult one-way fares: Valletta €7.50, Sliema €8.50, Buġibba €6.50
